const input = $input.first().json;

return [{
  json: {
    userId: input.user?.id || 'unknown',
    email: input.user?.email || '',
    name: input.user?.name || 'Player',
    avatarUrl: input.user?.picture || '',
    action: input.action || 'save',
    saveSlot: input.saveSlot ?? 0,
    timestamp: input.timestamp || Date.now(),
    level: input.character?.level ?? 1,
    exp: input.character?.exp ?? 0,
    hp: input.character?.hp ?? 200,
    maxHp: input.character?.maxHp ?? 200,
    mp: input.character?.mp ?? 200,
    maxMp: input.character?.maxMp ?? 200,
    coins: input.character?.coins ?? 0,
    currentMap: input.character?.currentMap ?? 1,
    playTime: input.stats?.playTime ?? 0,
    killCount: input.stats?.killCount ?? 0,
    inventoryJson: JSON.stringify(input.inventory || []),
    hotbarJson: JSON.stringify(input.hotbar || [])
  }
}];
